in_marathi.name: Tharun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Radiant, Young
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tharun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tharun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tharunam' which means 'Sun'. This name is also associated with the radiant and young sun. It signifies vitality, vision, and wisdom.
